title: Prism Beta 3: Final Beta but Make it FUN
message: Welcome to Beta 3! This new Beta now includes fresh new features to; Sand Box 3D, Rift Runners 2D, etc. So, what was changed inside Sand Box 3D? What changed was the Build Mode feature, instead of LockJoints, it draws direct inspiration from MInecraft's block placements! You can now build things from your mind, collide with them, or ANYTHiNG ELSE IMAGINABLE! But what about Rift Runners 2D? The changes were a lot more fun. Prices for items in Rift Shop has been adjusted, a bug fix that was reported by one of our co-devs. The fun change in Rift Runners 2D is the phase system, it now features Moon and Bloodmoon phases, you can only get into them riht after defeating the boss, but it is not always guaranteed to get the phase...
